purpose: Teach: ごちそう/居眠り/ばったり/噴水/観賞/トランペット/ガッカリ/折りたたみ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お祝いの、本気で、絶対、ごちそう、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、用意したいわ
lines.en: Aoi, I really want to prepare a proper celebration feast for you — I mean it.
lines.style: Warm, generous opening. Slight emphasis on the commitment. Soft but resolute. Leaning in like she's making a promise.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。お昼休み、本気で、絶対、葵、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、居眠り、絶対、しちゃったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, well — I actually dozed off during lunch break, if I'm being honest.
lines.style: Slightly self-deprecating, wry. A small laugh under the surface. Confessional tone, like admitting something small that matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 駅で、本気で、絶対、昔のクラスメート、絶対、ばったり、絶対、葵、絶対、会えたわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And then at the station — I ran into an old classmate out of nowhere.
lines.style: Animated, surprised. Forward momentum on the discovery. Genuine delight in the coincidence. Light, conversational pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お店の前の、本気で、絶対、噴水、絶対、お客様の、絶対、目印に、絶対、なってるよ、葵で、メイちゃん
lines.en: The fountain out front has become such a good landmark for customers to find us.
lines.style: Reflective, noticing detail. Quiet pride in the small thing. Observant tone, not rushed. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵で、本気で、絶対、お花の、絶対、観賞、絶対、コーナー、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、お洒落と思うわ
lines.en: I think that flower display corner you set up really does look elegant.
lines.style: Genuine praise, unhurried. Warm appreciation for the specific touch. Sincere, not flattering. Soft admiration underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、トランペット、絶対、BGM、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、流してるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: We've actually got trumpet music playing softly as background music now.
lines.style: Light, upbeat. Sharing a small joy. Cheerful but genuine, not performative. Open and inclusive tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 仕入れミスで、本気で、絶対、葵、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、ガッカリ、絶対、したわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Though we did have a stock mix-up that left me a bit disappointed, honestly.
lines.style: Wry, rueful. Acknowledging the small letdown without dwelling. Self-aware laugh underneath. Honest and unbitter.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お買い物の時、本気で、絶対、折りたたみ、絶対、エコバッグ、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、活用してね、葵
lines.en: When you're shopping, please make sure you use that reusable bag — it helps.
lines.style: Warm, gently encouraging close. Gentle suggestion, not instruction. The care of someone looking out for you. Ending on a soft, hopeful note.
